title: Application to Study Permit Process Steps for Lithuania
notice: Lithuania has no Embassy in Bangladesh. Bangladeshi students can submit visa applications via VFS Global Dhaka → Lithuanian Embassy New Delhi, OR at Honorary Consulates in Malaysia, Philippines, or Thailand. Lithuania uses a TRP (Temporary Residence Permit) system via MIGRIS — not a standard long-stay visa.

processSteps.label: University Application : via university portal
bullets: Application window: January–April for September intake
University Application Fee : €0–30 depending on university

processSteps.label: Offer Letter → Request Mediation Letter from University
bullets: Offer Letter is the prerequisite to request a Mediation Letter from the institution
Mediation Letter is mandatory for non-EU students applying for TRP

processSteps.label: PCC Legalization : ৩ ধাপে বাধ্যতামূলক
bullets: Step 2 — Bangladesh Embassy Poland: লিথুয়ানিয়ায় বাংলাদেশের কোনো Embassy নেই, নিকটস্থটি পোল্যান্ডে
Step 3 — Lithuanian MoFA: সবশেষে Lithuanian MOFA থেকে legalization

processSteps.label: Financial Proof : minimum €8,077 in bank
bullets: Bank statement: last 3–6 months | With Income Source proof

costSteps.label: Book Student Housing / Dormitory
bullets: Housing confirmation required for TRP application

costSteps.label: Arrange Health Insurance
bullets: Mandatory — minimum €30,000 coverage, entire study period

costSteps.label: Indian Visa : required to travel to New Delhi for visa submission
Submit Application :
bullets: Option A — MIGRIS → forwards to Lithuanian Embassy New Delhi
Option B — MIGRIS → Consulates in Malaysia, Philippines, or Thailand

costSteps.label: Air Ticket to Lithuania : varies by season and route
